scripts.build: bun scripts/build-character-fills.mjs && bun scripts/sync-excalidraw-fonts.mjs && bun run check:breve-runtime && tsc && vite build
scripts.build:web: bun scripts/build-character-fills.mjs && bun scripts/sync-excalidraw-fonts.mjs && tsc && ROTLI_WEB_BASE=/app/ ROTLI_PLATFORM=web vite build
scripts.build:mac: bun scripts/build-tray-icon.mjs && bash scripts/predmg-clean.sh && bun run tauri build --bundles app
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:breve && bun run test:tooling && bun run test:relay
scripts.test:evals: bun test src/ai/chatTitleEval.test.ts src/ai/hybrid.test.ts src/ai/loop.test.ts src/ai/models.test.ts src/ai/prompt.test.ts src/chatMemory/retrieval.test.ts src/chatMemory/workflow.test.ts
scripts.test:breve: bun breve-runtime/tests/test-actions.ts && bun breve-runtime/tests/test-intents.ts && bun breve-runtime/tests/test-timectx.ts && bun breve-runtime/tests/test-retention.ts && bun breve-runtime/tests/test-pdf-theme.ts && bun breve-runtime/tests/test-scheduler-retry.ts && bun breve-runtime/tests/test-doctor-findings.ts && bun test ./breve-runtime/tests/test-chrome-pdf.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-secret-stdin.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-process-lock.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-delivery-claim.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-watcher-failure.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-safe-fetch-fixtures.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-markdown-text.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-config-locality.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-provider-policy.ts ./breve-runtime/tests/test-render-document.ts
scripts.test:regression: bun run test && bun run test:evals && bun run check:breve-runtime && bun run check:design-system
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json && tsc --noEmit -p services/rotli-mcp-relay
scripts.typecheck:tsc6: node_modules/typescript6/bin/tsc --noEmit && node_modules/typescript6/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && node_modules/typescript6/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json && node_modules/typescript6/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json && node_modules/typescript6/bin/tsc --noEmit -p breve-runtime && node_modules/typescript6/bin/tsc --noEmit -p services/rotli-mcp-relay
scripts.lint: bun run --parallel typecheck check:e2e-types typecheck:tsc6 format:check check:code-shape check:react-compiler check:naming check:hex check:architecture check:ipc check:secret-parity check:parity check:structure check:security check:knip check:docs check:ratchets check:window-events check:web-privacy check:dup:gate && bun run lint:oxlint
scripts.lint:serial: bun run typecheck && bun run check:e2e-types && bun run typecheck:tsc6 && bun run format:check && bun run check:code-shape && bun run check:react-compiler && bun run check:naming && bun run check:hex && bun run check:architecture && bun run check:ipc && bun run check:secret-parity && bun run check:parity && bun run check:structure && bun run check:security && bun run check:knip && bun run check:docs && bun run check:ratchets && bun run check:window-events && bun run check:web-privacy && bun run check:dup:gate && bun run lint:oxlint
scripts.lint:oxlint: oxlint --disable-nested-config -c .oxlintrc.json --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=error src e2e scripts breve-runtime services/rotli-mcp-relay playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts
scripts.check:breve-runtime: bun build breve-runtime/scripts/*.ts --target bun --outdir $(mktemp -d) && tsc --noEmit -p breve-runtime && bash -n breve-runtime/scripts/morning-brief.sh && bash -n breve-runtime/scripts/lunch-brief.sh && bash -n breve-runtime/scripts/night-brief.sh && bash -n breve-runtime/scripts/custom-brief.sh && bun run check:breve-contract
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run test:regression
